description: Production observability entry point. Cloudflare production Workers use live native analytics. Vercel deployment telemetry is not yet connected; native project links remain available.

targets.root_selector: if ((.errors // []) | length) > 0 then error("Cloudflare Workers Analytics returned an error") else [.data.viewer.accounts[0].workersInvocationsAdaptive[] | {worker:.dimensions.scriptName,environment:(if (.dimensions.scriptName|endswith("-preview")) then "preview" else "production" end),status:.dimensions.status,requests:.sum.requests,errors:.sum.errors,subrequests:.sum.subrequests,cpu_ms_p50:(.quantiles.cpuTimeP50/1000),cpu_ms_p99:(.quantiles.cpuTimeP99/1000)}] end | map(select(.environment == "production"))

panels.title: Production Worker requests, errors and CPU

options.content: Cloudflare production Workers: live requests, execution errors and CPU from native Analytics. Zero observed errors is not an end-to-end availability check. Vercel deployment telemetry is not yet connected; use the native project links above. Application traces, database health and zone WAF signals are not available on this overview.
